data.narrative: The student demonstrated outstanding systems architecture depth during Module 02. They correctly justified PostgreSQL over document-based storage based on multi-tenant referential integrity and avoiding 16MB document size limits for click events, designed a robust relational schema with compound B-Tree indexes, and accurately identified application-level short-code collision handling under high concurrency.

dimension_scores.observation: Analyzed document storage vs relational models, recognizing the hazards of 16MB document bloat and unindexed cross-collection lookups versus relational indexing and strict foreign key integrity.
dimension_scores.evidence: Chose Option A (PostgreSQL) pointing out document size caps when embedding analytics vs dedicated relational tables.

dimension_scores.observation: Differentiated between database-level constraint enforcement and application seed/creation logic when diagnosing unique constraint error P2002.
dimension_scores.evidence: Correctly diagnosed that schema constraints were working as expected and isolated the duplicate slug insertion in the seed script.

dimension_scores.observation: Recognized raw IP addresses as PII under GDPR/CCPA regulations and advocated for salted cryptographic hashing (HMAC) to support analytics and fraud detection without data retention risk.
dimension_scores.evidence: Identified GDPR/CCPA PII classification and recommended irreversible salted hashing to protect user data and limit blast radius.

dimension_scores.observation: Understood the performance hazards of full table scans on public redirect paths and the risk of write lock contention when tracking clicks inline.
dimension_scores.evidence: Explained how O(N) sequential scans exhaust CPU/IOPS under redirect traffic, and why append-only click tracking prevents write locks on link records.

dimension_scores.observation: Communicated complex database engine mechanisms with high technical precision and concise, structured explanations.
dimension_scores.evidence: Consistently answered with structured breakdowns covering engine execution, regulatory compliance, and architectural tradeoffs.

strengths: Deep comprehension of database indexing (B-Tree O(log N) point lookups vs O(N) full table scans).
Strong security instincts regarding multi-tenant data boundaries and privacy compliance (GDPR/CCPA IP anonymization).
Production-grade awareness of concurrency issues, such as TOCTOU race conditions and row lock contention.
growth_areas: Continue applying this strict multi-tenant boundary discipline as we introduce route handlers and tenant authentication middleware in Module 03.
data.recommendation: Maintain this rigorous architectural focus when implementing tenant authorization and route validations in Module 03.
